water_stress.note: pending Alaa (recent-window choice) - see logs/step1_report.md finding c

rainfall_trend.label: no clear trend
rainfall_trend.mbb_note: detrended moving block bootstrap (overlapping 3-year residual blocks) preserves short-term autocorrelation, so its interval is typically wider than the analytical one when annual rainfall is autocorrelated; per-decade keys, per-year twins with _per_year suffix

soil_water_capacity.method: Saxton & Rawls (2006) Soil Sci Soc Am J 70:1569-1578 Table 1 Eqs 1-2 pedotransfer from ISRIC SoilGrids sand/silt/clay + SOC (OM = SOC x 1.724)
soil_water_capacity.unit: mm of plant-available water per m soil
soil_water_capacity.confidence_note: pedotransfer estimate (Saxton & Rawls 2006) from SoilGrids 250 m model texture, not a lab measurement; texture fractions sum to ~100%; pedotransfer inputs consistent

ndvi.source: MODIS MOD13Q1 250 m via ORNL DAAC REST (offline from data/raw)
ndvi.caveat: no cropland mask (ESA WorldCover class 40 not applied), no pixel QA filter, 5 years only

historical_drought.method: SPI-like annual rainfall z-score: z = (rain - mean) / std over the window; severe drought year = z <= -1.0 (WMO SPI 'severely dry' boundary, pending Younes)
historical_drought.confidence_note: single climate source (NASA POWER); boundary threshold pending Younes; z-scores are distribution-based, not a fitted SPI distribution

rule_trace.purpose: plain-English why for every level/flag/priority; each string cites the exact rule and the numbers stored in this file
rule_trace.water_stress: Flagged because the mean annual rainfall of 2015-2024 (603.8 mm) is 16.7% below this region's own 1995-2014 reference mean (rule: deficit / 0.30, capped at 1.0 — PRD v3 section 6.2 rescaling). Definition still pending Alaa.
rule_trace.organic_carbon: Soil flagged as medium because top-30-cm organic carbon is 17.08 g/kg and the rule is low < 10, medium 10-20, high > 20 g/kg (low < 10.0, medium 10.0-20.0, high > 20.0 g/kg (pending Younes), pending Younes).
rule_trace.soil_water_capacity: AWC 140.1 mm/m is flagged as an estimate because it comes from the Saxton & Rawls (2006) pedotransfer applied to SoilGrids model texture (250 m pixel), not from lab measurement; field capacity 34.8 vol%, wilting point 20.8 vol%.
rule_trace.rainfall_trend: Trend flagged 'no clear trend' because OLS p=0.125 and Mann-Kendall p=0.1435 (both must be < 0.05 and same sign); Sen slope -46.4 mm/decade; the moving block bootstrap 95% CI is [-117.7, 20.5] mm/decade (includes 0, so it is not significant at 95%).
rule_trace.hot_days: Counted only inside the grain-filling window (months [4, 5, 6]) when daily max temperature exceeds 35.0 degrees C (threshold pending Younes); value is the 1995-2024 mean of yearly counts = 9.7 days/yr.
rule_trace.frost_days: Counted only inside the late-frost window (months [3, 4]) when daily min temperature is below 0.0 degrees C; value is the 1995-2024 mean of yearly counts = 0.4 nights/yr.
rule_trace.extreme_rain_days: Counted per calendar year whenever daily rain exceeds 20.0 mm; value is the 1995-2024 mean.
rule_trace.longest_dry_spell_days: A dry day is rain < 1.0 mm (strict), and spells are never merged across missing days; only the growing season (months [10, 11, 12, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) is searched.
rule_trace.historical_drought: 20.0% of the years in 1995-2024 were severe droughts (annual rain <= 539.0 mm, i.e. z <= -1.0): [2000, 2001, 2016, 2021, 2022, 2024]. Boundary pending Younes.
rule_trace.suggested_priorities: Weights follow PRD v3 section 6.2: water need = min(1, stress/0.3) using stress 0.1668; soil need = 1.0/0.5/0.1 for low/medium/high SOC (class medium); yield gets the remainder, floor 0.2; the three needs are rescaled to sum 100 with largest-remainder rounding (got 37/33/30).
rule_trace.ph: pH 7.5 is the 0-30 cm depth-weighted SoilGrids pH(H2O) estimate; reported without a level flag because no pH banding rule has been agreed yet.
rule_trace.ndvi: Yield baseline is a rough proxy: mean spring peak NDVI of a 5x5 km MODIS patch (2020-2024), normalized 0.25-0.75 to [0,1]; no cropland mask, no pixel QA filter, 5 years only.
